title: When the Salt Sings
author: Odile Villalobos
blurb: Ines Hartwell, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
